title: BBC Learning English from the News 2026 — Quiz 4
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q031_transplant
elements.title: Once the saplings are strong enough, gardeners will ___ them from their pots into the ground.

elements.name: q032_first_of_its_kind
elements.title: The organisers called it a ___ exhibition because nobody had ever staged a show like it before.

elements.name: q033_bridge
elements.title: The temporary grant acts as a ___ until permanent funding arrives.

elements.name: q034_not_over
elements.title: “The competition is not over.” What is the speaker saying?
choices: The competition was cancelled before it started.
The winners have already been announced.
There is still more of the competition to come.
The final results can no longer change.
elements.correctAnswer: There is still more of the competition to come.

elements.name: q035_trigger
elements.title: A sharp noise can ___ the alarm, causing it to sound immediately.

elements.name: q036_wipe_out
elements.title: The corrupted file could ___ all our saved work if the only copy is unreadable.

elements.name: q037_go_rogue
elements.title: What does it mean if a character decides to “go rogue” during a mission in a novel?
choices: The character acts independently and ignores the plan.
The character withdraws before the mission starts.
The character asks permission at every step.
elements.correctAnswer: The character acts independently and ignores the plan.

elements.name: q038_spree
elements.title: The shop's sale led to a spending ___, with customers making several purchases in a few hours.

elements.name: q039_overdone
elements.title: The reviewer thought the acting was ___: every minor setback was played as a tragedy.

elements.name: q040_pivotal
elements.title: The vote was ___ because its outcome would determine whether the project could proceed.
